package lint

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// Loaded by the documented Go overlay so the rule owns every changed file.
func TestPropertiesParameterSelected(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	directory, err := filepath.Abs(".")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	oracle := goOracle(t)
	const name = "structure/react-component-require-properties-parameter"
	var rows []string
	for _, row := range upstream(t) {
		fields := strings.Split(row, "\t")
		if len(fields) > 1 && fields[1] == name {
			rows = append(rows, row)
		}
	}
	if len(rows) < 13 {
		t.Fatalf("upstream capture lost cases: %d", len(rows))
	}
	t.Logf("upstream cases: %d", len(rows))
	for _, descriptor := range prepareRegistry(t, directory) {
		if descriptor.Name != name {
			continue
		}
		witnesses := ownedWitnessRows(t, directory, descriptor)
		for _, row := range witnesses {
			answer := execute(t, "", oracle, "--manifest", manifest(t, []string{row}), "--count")
			if string(answer.output) == "0\n" {
				t.Fatalf("silent witness: %s", row)
			}
			rows = append(rows, row, strings.SplitN(row, "\t", 2)[0]+"\tall")
		}
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		for _, row := range generated(t) {
			path := strings.SplitN(row, "\t", 2)[0]
			if !seen[path] {
				rows = append(rows, path+"\t"+name)
				seen[path] = true
			}
		}
		t.Logf("witnesses: %d; inherited sources: %d", len(witnesses), len(seen))
		compare(t, oracle, buildPort(t, directory, true), directory, manifest(t, recoveryRows(t, oracle, rows)))
		var change struct{ Name, From, To string }
		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("rules", descriptor.Slug, "mutant.json"))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = json.Unmarshal(data, &change); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		path := manifest(t, witnesses)
		want := execute(t, "", oracle, "--manifest", path).output
		changed := mutant(t, change.From, change.To, filepath.Join("rules", descriptor.Slug, descriptor.Module))
		native := buildMutantPort(t, changed)
		for _, side := range []struct {
			name string
			run  execution
		}{
			{"Node", node(t, changed, path, false)},
			{"emitted JavaScript", emittedNode(t, changed, path, false)},
			{"sanitized native", execute(t, "", native, "--manifest", path)},
		} {
			if bytes.Equal(side.run.output, want) {
				t.Fatalf("mutant survived on %s", side.name)
			}
			t.Logf("%s caught on %s: %s", change.Name, side.name, difference(side.run.output, want))
		}
	}
}
